entries.title: Psalms 41:1
segments: <<For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.>> Blessed is he that considereth the poor: Jehovah will deliver him in the day of evil.

entries.title: Psalms 41:2
segments: Jehovah will preserve him, and keep him alive, And he shall be blessed upon the earth; And deliver not thou him unto the will of his enemies.

entries.title: Psalms 41:3
segments: Jehovah will support him upon the couch of languishing: Thou makest all his bed in his sickness.

entries.title: Psalms 41:4
segments: I said, O Jehovah, have mercy upon me: Heal my soul; for I have sinned against thee.

entries.title: Psalms 41:5
segments: Mine enemies speak evil against me, [saying], When will he die, and his name perish?

entries.title: Psalms 41:6
segments: And if he come to see [me], he speaketh falsehood; His heart gathereth iniquity to itself: When he goeth abroad, he telleth it.

entries.title: Psalms 41:7
segments: All that hate me whisper together against me; Against me do they devise my hurt.

entries.title: Psalms 41:8
segments: An evil disease, [say they], cleaveth fast unto him; And now that he lieth he shall rise up no more.

entries.title: Psalms 41:9
segments: Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, Who did eat of my bread, Hath lifted up his heel against me.

entries.title: Psalms 41:10
segments: But thou, O Jehovah, have mercy upon me, and raise me up, That I may requite them.

entries.title: Psalms 41:11
segments: By this I know that thou delightest in me, Because mine enemy doth not triumph over me.

entries.title: Psalms 41:12
segments: And as for me, thou upholdest me in mine integrity, And settest me before thy face for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 41:13
segments: Blessed be Jehovah, the God of Israel, From everlasting and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen.
